comment: Fleet model registry. One entry per deployable model. 'scope' decides the eviction rule: 'band' = its hosts only, 'fleet' = all 16 sparks (evicts everything, including the always-on models). The big-model band and the fleet-wide slot are mutually exclusive: exactly one 'current' big model at a time, designated via tools/fleet_swap.sh.

Ports are the multidev lane-1 block (lane_assignments.json); the old always-on block 17480/61620/58700 is retired. The COORDINATION-era qwen38.bf16.pp16 runtime root never existed on the nodes; bf16 TP4 pack regen is in the rotation queue.
